operator_notes: Wix homepage redesigned since original training (checked 2026-08-10):
images are no longer alt-tagged with 'Bulletin' at all (now plain
DDMMYY-0.jpg .. DDMMYY-3.jpg, 4 pages instead of the original 2), so
the old img[alt*='Bulletin'] selector matched 0 images. Widened to a
bare 'img' selector — the existing min_long_side/min_short_side size
filter alone already correctly excludes the logo/hero/Mass-times
decorative images (all comfortably under the 700x500 threshold) and
keeps only the genuinely full-page scans, so no alt-text match is
needed. count raised from 2 to 4 to match the site's current layout.
Older weeks stay on the page as large images above — harvester must
take the last matching set, not the first.
No PDF file exists; image_stack merges the pages into one PDF.
NOTE: as of 2026-08-10 the newest available images are still dated
120726 (12th July) — the site itself hasn't posted a newer bulletin in
4+ weeks. If the site reverts to a 2-image layout, count=4 will
correctly fail loudly (found N != 4) rather than silently grabbing the
wrong images — re-check the live layout if this recurs.
disable_stale_rescrape_fallback is set on purpose (checked 2026-08-10):
the image_stack recipe above correctly extracts the true page images and
correctly gets marked stale (source is 12th July). Without this flag, the
generic stale-retry rescrape re-scans the homepage for 'any img', which on
this Wix layout can pick up an unrelated hashed-filename decorative CDN
asset (no date in the URL at all) and render just that single image as a
1-page PDF via html_render — that passes the freshness check purely
because no date could be extracted from the hash URL, silently reporting
a false ok with the wrong, non-bulletin image. Trust the recipe's own
stale verdict instead; re-check manually once the site posts a newer
dated bulletin.
do_not: Do not use copy-of-sunday-missalette or Wix PDF viewer blob URLs.
Do not use download *.pdf — there is no bulletin PDF.
Do not Save page as PDF — that captures every archived bulletin on the homepage.
